# Midnight reference theme

This package contains two theme variants. It does not contain a worker.
It does not request network access or other permissions.
The example repository URL uses a reserved domain.
Use the local development package option to install this folder.

1. Do a check of the package permissions.
2. Give installation approval.
3. Enable the add-on.
4. In Appearance settings, select Midnight.

Installation does not select the theme.
An explicit accent selection overrides the theme accent.
High contrast, UI scale, and reduced transparency also override theme values.
If you disable or remove the package, the app uses the built-in theme.
To remove the saved theme selection, select the built-in theme.

This package changes colors, control radii, panel radii, and panel opacity.
It does not change the interface layout, control functions, navigation, or UI hooks.
